stem:
The total number of keys on a computer keyboard is 87.

• There are 26 letter keys and 21 special symbol keys on the keyboard.
• The rest of the keys are function keys.

Which model represents one way to find the number of function keys on the keyboard?

options.label: A
options.text: Number line with sections labeled Function (0 to 26), Special symbol (26 to 47), Letter (47 to 87)

options.label: B
options.text: Bar model with total 87 above, parts 26, 21, and ? in a row

options.label: C
options.text: Number line with sections labeled Special symbol (0 to 21), Letter (21 to 26), Function (26 to 87)

options.label: D
options.text: Bar model with parts 26, 21, and 87 below, and ? above

visual_elements: Number line labeled A: 0 to 90, divided into Function, Special symbol, Letter segments in that order from left to right
Bar model labeled B: total 87 with parts 26, 21, and ?
Number line labeled C: 0 to 90, divided into Special symbol, Letter, Function segments in that order from left to right
Bar model labeled D: parts 26, 21, and 87 with ? above
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of parts-whole relationships and interpreting different models; involves subtracting known parts from total to find unknown part.
